static_traits.name: Lin Kexin
static_traits.family_status: Close relationship with the elder brother; a few months ago a family member made negative evaluations of their singing
static_traits.medical_history: Denies past similar psychological problems and treatment; no major physical illness
static_traits.language_features: Clear expression, high cooperativeness, fairly steady speech rate and emotions; nervous at the start, hesitating over how much to share; harsh self-evaluation, with self-doubt

basic_info.main_problem: Enjoys singing in the shower but believes they sing very poorly, causing self-doubt and feelings of insufficiency.
basic_info.core_demands: Hoping to improve through counseling because persistent self-doubt and negative thoughts about singing ability affect confidence and overall mood.
growth_experiences: Singing used to bring the client joy and relaxation (in the shower or along with the radio); a few months ago a family member's negative comment started producing self-doubt, and since then each singing session is often triggered by that comment, gradually making singing hard to enjoy.

core_beliefs: I am not good enough / have no ability.
My value depends on others' evaluations.

special_situations.event: A few months ago, family gave negative evaluations of one's singing
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If family all negate my singing, it means I am really bad and should not sing.
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Trying hard to improve by watching online tutorials, to prove not being that bad.

special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I do not sing well, I do not deserve to sing, nor should I enjoy it.
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Constantly self-monitoring and fault-picking while singing, trying to correct every 'flaw'.
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I sing terribly; I should not sing.

special_situations.event: Thinking about others possibly hearing one sing
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If others do not want to listen or do not like it, it proves I am bad and will be mocked or judged.
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoiding discussing this with others (e.g. not yet talking with elder brother), to reduce chances of being evaluated.
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: No one will want to hear me sing.

special_situations.event: Self-evaluating one's own singing after watching online tutorials
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If there is no obvious progress in the short term, it proves I am really no good.
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Repeatedly finding and magnifying shortcomings, ignoring the pleasure singing brings.
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I am still no good; no matter how I learn it is useless.

core_conflict.wish: Longing to be seen and heard affirmatively, to freely express and enjoy the joy of singing
core_conflict.fear: Fears being judged, humiliated, or rejected for expressing oneself
defense_goal: Lowering expectations through self-repression and self-denial, to avoid being hurt by negative evaluations again
Keeping distance (not discussing distress with close people) to maintain safety

object_relations.self_representation: A singer not good enough, error-prone, needing correction
object_relations.object_representation: Critical judges / others who may negate me

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor invites me to share more inner feelings or explore past positive experiences
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Worrying that exposed vulnerability will be judged or not understood (transference: seeing others as potential judges)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: In a steady tone, wording cautiously ('maybe/not sure'), using few emotion words, responding briefly, avoiding deep personal emotional detail.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When advised to communicate with an older brother and seek support
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Anticipating the other person will not understand or will even negate me (transference: projection)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Declining attempts with expressions like 'he might not understand / it may not help', in a hesitant tone, avoiding clear commitments.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When recalling that negative comment from family
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Turning dissatisfaction and hurt toward others into self-blame (turning anger against the self)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Reinforcing self-blaming statements (e.g. 'I am simply no good'), in a low tone, avoiding expressing true emotions toward others.

manifestations: Not having shared self-doubt and distress with the close elder brother
Feeling isolated and misunderstood in singing and expressing interests
outcomes: Reducing expression and help-seeking, deepening inner isolation

manifestations: Shrinking self-expression due to others' evaluations, struggling to freely enjoy singing
Constant self-monitoring while singing, fearing mistakes
Singing, once a source of joy and relaxation, no longer brings pleasure

contact_model.definition: The individual has poor self-reflection and excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact.
manifestations: Expressing uncertainty at the start about how much to share, appearing nervous
Excessive self-judgment while singing, constantly fault-picking
Anticipating change with 'might not work / too hard'

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others, believing others will see them negatively.
manifestations: Believing 'no one will want to hear me sing'
Worrying the elder brother will not understand their feelings, hence not communicating

contact_model.definition: The individual restrains impulses to express outward and seek help, turning the energy toward themselves instead (such as self-blame and self-demands).
manifestations: Not yet seeking help from the close elder brother, turning instead to self-denial and self-criticism
Turning dissatisfaction and hurt inward, not expressing outward

exception_events.target_problem: Often troubled by self-denial and worry about others' evaluations when singing (especially in the shower), low mood and struggling to enjoy singing.
exception_events.unique_outcome: At certain moments before the family's negative comment (e.g. singing along with the radio or in the shower), she did not judge herself but focused on melody and relaxation, experiencing joy and freedom.
exception_events.reason: Clues: different situation (no one else present then, not yet affected by negative feedback); different approach (attention on experience and joy rather than performance right or wrong), so she stayed engaged and gained pleasure that time.

positive_force: Has genuine interest and motivation in singing (proactively watches online tutorials)
Can recall past positive experiences and is willing to try reframing thoughts
Close relationship with older brother; potential support resources exist
Willing to cooperate with practice and try new strategies (such as restructuring and behavioral experiments)
negative_force: Marked self-doubt, prone to negative labeling
Caring too much about others' evaluations and mind-reading inferences
One negative review overgeneralized into a stable ability defect
Ignoring positive evidence and experience, magnifying flaws
Low mood and avoiding help-seeking maintaining the problem

target_behavior.behavior: Self-deprecating automatic thoughts while singing (e.g. 'I am terrible' 'no one wants to hear me sing')
target_behavior.core_reason: Negative evaluations are internalized as judgments of ability and worth, accompanied by cognitive biases such as overgeneralization, mind reading, and all-or-nothing thinking.
target_behavior.function: Avoiding potential external criticism and shame through preemptive self-denial and self-contraction, reducing the risk of being hurt.
target_behavior.consequence: Decreased self-confidence, low mood, a once-beneficial relaxing activity taken away, reduced daily pleasure and satisfaction.

target_behavior.behavior: Avoids communicating inner troubles and seeking help from others (such as an elder brother)
antecedent: Thinking others may not understand or may evaluate negatively
When advised to try communicating with family
target_behavior.core_reason: Fearing being negated or not understood, projecting worries about others as certain negative reactions.
target_behavior.function: Escaping vulnerable exposure to maintain subjective safety, briefly lowering anxiety.
target_behavior.consequence: Social support not yet mobilized, sense of isolation and self-doubt maintained, negative beliefs reinforced.
